# ADR-0005 (accepted): Ray is the compute substrate

Binding for the files that loaded this rule.

Platform services run on Ray. Tenant-controlled and model-written code runs only through the SandboxRunner interface, backed on clusters by Ray Sandboxes (gVisor) with networking disabled. Ray itself is never the isolation boundary, and Ray actors never hold state that must survive a restart.

Invariants:
- INV-0005-1: Tenant-controlled or model-written Lean code never executes in a Ray worker process; it runs only through SandboxRunner.
- INV-0005-2: Every cluster sandbox that runs tenant-controlled or model-written code has networking disabled.
- INV-0005-3: Every cluster deployment enables Ray token authentication and exposes no dashboard, Jobs API or Ray Client endpoint to tenants.
- INV-0005-4: Ray Sandboxes and any other pre-release sandbox API are used only behind SandboxRunner.
- INV-0005-5: Nothing that must survive a cluster restart, such as run state or pending approvals, is held only in a Ray actor.
